_idx.description: Index in the original array of objects posted.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the account which owns the collaborator.

first_name.description: Given name of the collaborator if provided.

last_name.description: Surname of the collaborator if provided.

invitation_url.description: URL sent to the collaborator to activate their account; null if accepted.

invitation_status.description: Indicates whether the invite has been accepted (pending or accepted).

role.description: One of the following values - admin or editor.

website_ids.description: Array of website unique identifiers; only provided if the role is editor.

error.description: Error code when a collaborator cannot be created.

validation_errors.description: Array of validation error objects when the error is a validation error.
